desc: 背胶与螺丝双路径上墙，纸卷毛巾厨具离地收纳，冷灰石纹靛蓝信息图
leaf: 免打孔自粘橱柜下纸巾架
name: 免打孔自粘柜底纸巾架款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用一眼看清结构的白底图拿下点击。
先把纸卷横陈、台面被占满的日常摩擦摊开给买家看。
一秒讲清核心利益：贴到柜底或墙面，纸卷立刻离地悬空。
用同机位双栏对照把挂装后的清爽和没有它时的杂乱直接摆平。
把纸巾、保鲜膜、毛巾和厨具挂上墙的多用途场景一次讲完，让买家自我代入。
用三处微距证明做工与结构：折边底座、表面水珠、挡卷端帽。
解释安装机制：光面走背胶、毛面走螺丝，并列出两种墙面材质位。
用留空标尺与两条路径配件全家福消掉尺寸与随附件疑虑。
以挂重与淋水两处留白实证收口，把掉落与生锈的风险疑问关掉。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, cool stone and veined marble panels #EDEBE6 / #E2DFD9 / #E6E3DD for info and scene screens, brushed silver #D5D3CF for proof screens, one deep indigo #33408F graphic band as the only flat colour field
style.direction: minimal matte hardware commerce with circular-vignette infographics on cool stone-marble fields
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line rings, rounded pill placeholders and circular vignette frames in indigo #33408F, no glyphs rendered
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, controlled skimming sweep to read dark metal finishes, soft contact shadows only, daylight-balanced 5500K fill inside in-room vignettes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal matte-hardware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, cool stone and veined marble greys #EDEBE6 and #E2DFD9, near-black hardware line colour #24262A and a single deep indigo accent #33408F; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and a controlled skimming sweep on dark metal, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with every headline, pill, badge and callout shape left empty for post compositing; thin single-weight line ring and circular vignette icon language; believable in-room marble, tile and pale stone surfaces; stable product scale and mounting angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered lettering or invented figures.
noDrift: no warm beige or wood-dominant backgrounds
no inconsistent lighting or contradictory shadow directions
no filled-in text, numbers or certification seals inside placeholder shapes
style.presentationRules: the same slight 3/4 or clean side-profile read of the product across packshot, scene and spec screens, stable scale, product never occluded by props or hands, one idea per screen
style.surfaceSystem: veined marble and glazed tile wall planes, pale stone counter tops, cabinet undersides in pale oak grey, matte white info cards
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for the layout only; all headline, label and callout shapes stay empty so copy can be composited later
